note: Game-only profile. Unlike the other games here it carries NO ranges and NO relays, and that is the point rather than an omission: a Minecraft server is whichever one the player joins, and its address is not published, fixed, or capturable by us. It is typed into Settings and resolved to a /32 at connect. What this file has to supply is the game itself - its id, its name, and the processes the watcher looks for - so that a typed address has a game to attach to. It is deliberately safe to merge into a licensed installation: see TunnelEngine.LoadProfileAsync, which only ever takes shipped files that declare no ranges.
